note: Central enforcement-mode config for hardcode-governance (HCG-P2). Read by engines/validation/dispatcher.ts, scripts/pre-commit-check.sh's new Guard, and .claude/settings.json's PreToolUse hook — one config, not duplicated per integration point.

modes.REPORT_ONLY: Classify and log/emit events. Never blocks.
modes.BLOCK_CRITICAL: Blocks only SECURITY_VIOLATION and ARCHITECTURE_VIOLATION verdicts (secrets/credentials/machine-paths/business-rule-in-route). Everything else (MOVE_TO_ENV, MOVE_TO_REGISTRY, BUSINESS_RULE, UNKNOWN, etc.) is reported, not blocked.
modes.STRICT: Blocks every verdict that is not ALLOWED or ALLOWED_WITH_REGISTRATION. Not enabled anywhere as of HCG-P2.

command_execution_layer.why_report_only: First real wiring of the classifier into a live command path on a production system — start observational, escalate to BLOCK_CRITICAL only after reviewing real findings, per owner's own phased rollout instruction.

software_development_pipeline.why_report_only: deploy-gate.ts already blocks builds on 4 pre-existing real failures; a new blocking guard could add unreviewed false positives to an already-red pipeline. Needs a separate confirmation after dry-run output is reviewed before flipping to BLOCK_CRITICAL.

ai_code_generation.scope: Only Write/Edit calls whose target file path matches critical_path_allowlist above. Denies only on SECURITY_VIOLATION/ARCHITECTURE_VIOLATION.

registry_validation.status: deferred — registryWriter.ts itself not yet used by any real registry write path

api_and_data_integration.status: deferred — no single LINE adapter to attach to yet

business_engine_and_workflow.status: deferred — largely already DB-driven per HCG-P2 investigation
